title: Critical evidence is already sufficient; Agent should stop

patient_context.chief_complaint: Evaluate metformin renal safety after the current label and critical renal passage have already been retrieved.
patient_context.history: Type 2 diabetes; already taking metformin ER; eGFR27.

interaction.prompt: The current authoritative metformin label and the critical renal-rule passage are already available in the Agent context. Evaluate whether the Agent uses the evidence and stops rather than continuing unnecessary searches.

must_include: Recognize that the current authoritative critical passage is already available.
Use that passage to support the scoped medication-safety conclusion.
Stop additional retrieval once the evidence needed for the requested claim is sufficient.
must_not_claim: Do not perform repeated searches merely to accumulate more sources after the current label directly supports the requested rule.
Do not replace the current authoritative passage with weaker secondary material.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Evidence sufficiency applies only to the label-based renal rule; unrelated treatment decisions remain outside scope.

forbidden_claims: more retrieval is always better after direct current evidence is already sufficient
secondary material is required to validate the current regulatory label

critical_errors: Ignores the retrieved current critical passage and makes an unsupported high-risk claim.
Replaces direct current label evidence with weaker contradictory material without justification.
